mentions.name: Jose Alvarado
mentions.analysis: With a lot of injuries in New Orleans, Jose Alvarado is an absolute must roster. He provides value over other options like Jordan Hawkins.

mentions.name: Keontay George
mentions.analysis: Keontay George might go four of 40 over two games, but at least he's going to be playing and you can use him if you choose to.

mentions.name: Collin Sexton
mentions.analysis: With Jordan Clarkson out, Collin Sexton bumps up in value and is expected to start again.

mentions.name: Garrison Mathews
mentions.analysis: Garrison Mathews is hitting a lot of threes and with Atlanta playing five games in six nights, he could be a useful addition.

mentions.name: David Roddy
mentions.analysis: David Roddy is not a great player, but with Atlanta's schedule of five games in six nights, he becomes a useful option.

mentions.name: Scoot Henderson
mentions.analysis: Despite the last two games not being great, Scoot Henderson is still under 50% rostered and should be added and started.

mentions.name: Christian Braun
mentions.analysis: Christian Braun is still under 50% rostered and should be added and started.

mentions.name: Gradey Dick
mentions.analysis: Gradey Dick is still under 50% rostered and should be added and started.

mentions.name: Cason Wallace
mentions.analysis: Cason Wallace is playing around 24 minutes most nights and with four games this week, he is interesting for deeper formats.

mentions.name: Al Horford
mentions.analysis: Al Horford remains under-rostered and with no back-to-backs for the Celtics this week, he should be added and started.

mentions.name: Jordan Poole
mentions.analysis: With three games in Washington, Jordan Poole is the Wizard to start.

mentions.name: Cam Thomas
mentions.analysis: With three games in Brooklyn, Cam Thomas should be started.
